tldr: No direct Canadian competitor made a major retail move today. The notable signals come from adjacent players: 24/7 tokenized trading at NYSE and Binance, SoFi's tokenized deposit and stablecoin rollout, and voice and AI-driven banking in apps. CIBC and BMO only had investment-product listings (a CDR and an ETF).
themes: Earlier access to paychecks via direct deposit partnerships

highlights.headline: NYSE affiliate to launch 24/7 tokenized stock trading this month (WSJ); Binance to open 24/7 perpetual trading on Nubank and Freedom Holding stock
highlights.why: Round-the-clock equity access is moving from crypto into mainstream exchanges, and it will reset expectations for Direct Investing hours and settlement. The product team should assess where Simplii's trading offer stands.

highlights.headline: SoFi's SoFiUSD, billed as the first tokenized deposit product at a US bank, is now live on Polygon, its third chain, with reach to 17M members
highlights.why: A bank-issued stablecoin and tokenized deposits at a consumer-facing digital bank is a category signal for Simplii's longer-term payments and cross-border roadmap, even though it is US-only for now.

highlights.headline: CIBC launches an additional US Canadian Depositary Receipt (CDR)
highlights.why: CIBC, a sister brand and direct competitor in the same market, is widening low-friction CAD access to US equities. This is the most relevant Canadian move today and a benchmark for Simplii's Direct Investing offer.

highlights.headline: Banco do Brasil adds in-app voice calling ('Telefone BB'), and Starling launches an AI 'talk to transact' feature for setting up payments by voice
highlights.why: Voice and conversational interfaces are showing up in banking apps in two markets. This is worth considering for Simplii's digital-first support and payments flows.
